description: Test script for coupon code functionality in ERPNext, including setup of test data and a unit test for applying a coupon code to a sales order.

classes.name: TestCouponCode
classes.description: Unit test class for testing coupon code application in sales orders.

methods.name: test_create_test_data
methods.description: Creates test data including item, item price, pricing rule, sales partner, and coupon code.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test environment before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after each test, resetting user to Administrator.

methods.name: test_sales_order_with_coupon_code
methods.description: Tests applying a coupon code to a sales order and verifies the discount is applied.
